requirements.text: ledger.py check validates every rule in the spec, one error per line
Waves computed from dependencies; same-wave file conflicts rejected, directory prefixes included
ledger.py show: wave tables, requirement coverage, new dependencies and copied code, model summary
ledger.py next returns the earliest wave with unfinished tasks
ledger.py checkpoint runs verify and checks, reports out-of-scope files, logs to a file, --mark records done and appends the journal
status.py derives initiative states and prints full, --write and --brief output
SessionStart hook shows status, silent outside tech-lead projects, never blocks, TECH_LEAD_STATUS=0 disables it
Skill describes the full lead process from orientation to finish and resume
Skill states tiers, escalation ladder, lanes and turn economy
layout.md defines the document hierarchy, journal and backlog formats, .gitignore entries and the docs/superpowers migration offer
Scout, mockup, batch review and plan review prompt templates
Artifacts are always reported by absolute path
Plugin manifest, marketplace entry and READMEs
The plugin never switches or suggests the main session's model
Automatic plan review before the gate; autopilot mode agreed in advance skips the gate
